title: IT System Admin
description:
**Job Description**
**IT System Administrator | Litemed**
Role summary
  
  
Litemed is hiring an IT System Administrator to own day-to-day IT for about 100 employees: devices, network, cloud apps, security and support. You will be the go-to person for IT, keeping systems secure, available and simple to use.
  
  
**Job title**
IT System Administrator
**Department**
IT / Operations
**Reports to**
Head of Operations (or IT Manager)
**Team size**
Individual contributor; may guide 1 IT support executive
**Location**
[City], India – on-site, with occasional travel to branch sites
**Employment type**
Full-time, permanent
**Experience**
3–6 years in system administration
**Users supported**
~100 employees, ~120 endpoints
  
  
Key responsibilities
  
  
Infrastructure and network
  
  

* Install, configure and maintain servers, firewalls, switches, Wi-Fi access points and printers.
* Manage LAN/WAN, VPN, internet links and ISP relationships; keep uptime at 99%+ during business hours.
* Monitor system health, capacity and performance; fix issues before users notice.

End-user support
  
  

* Act as L1/L2 support for hardware, software, email and access issues via a ticketing system.
* Set up laptops, desktops and mobile devices for new joiners; recover and wipe them at exit.
* Train staff on IT tools and good security habits.

Cloud, identity and collaboration
  
  

* Administer Microsoft 365 or Google Workspace: users, licences, mailboxes, Teams/Drive, shared files.
* Manage Active Directory / Entra ID, group policies, MFA and single sign-on.
* Support business applications (ERP, HRMS, CRM) with vendors.

Security and backup
  
  

* Maintain antivirus/EDR, patching, firewall rules and access controls across all endpoints and servers.
* Run and test backups for servers, cloud data and critical files; keep a documented recovery plan.
* Respond to incidents such as phishing, malware or data loss, and report root cause.

Assets, vendors and budget
  
  

* Keep an up-to-date inventory of hardware, software licences and warranties.
* Evaluate and coordinate vendors, AMCs and purchases; help plan the annual IT budget.

Policy and compliance
  
  

* Write and enforce IT policies: acceptable use, passwords, access, data protection.
* Support audits and compliance with India's DPDP Act 2023 and any industry or customer requirements.
* Document systems, network diagrams and procedures.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT, Electronics or a related field (or equivalent experience).
* 3–6 years as a system or network administrator, ideally in a 50–500 user organisation.
* Hands-on with Windows Server, Active Directory, DNS, DHCP and Group Policy.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft 365 / Entra ID or Google Workspace administration.
* Networking basics: TCP/IP, VLANs, routing, firewalls (e.g. Fortinet, Sophos), VPN and Wi-Fi.
* Experience with endpoint management, patching and antivirus/EDR tools.
* Backup and recovery tools (e.g. Veeam, Acronis or cloud-native backup).
* Comfortable with basic scripting (PowerShell or Bash) to automate routine tasks.
* Experience using a ticketing system and writing clear documentation.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Certifications such as Microsoft Certified: Modern Desktop / Azure Administrator, CCNA, CompTIA Network+ or Security+.
* Experience with Intune or another MDM for laptops and mobiles.
* Exposure to AWS or Azure workloads and basic cloud cost control.
* Familiarity with ISO 27001 controls or IT audits.
* Experience in a healthcare, life-sciences or regulated environment, including handling sensitive data.
* Basic CCTV, biometric access and IP telephony support.

Skills and attributes
  
  

* Calm, methodical problem-solver who explains technical issues in plain language.
* Service-minded and patient with non-technical users.
* Organised; keeps documentation and asset records current.
* Trustworthy with confidential data and admin access.
* Willing to be on call for critical outages and to do planned maintenance outside business hours.

How success is measured
  
  
**Area**
**Target in first 12 months**
**Ticket response**
First response within 1 business hour; 90% resolved within SLA
**Uptime**
99%+ for network, email and core apps during business hours
**Patching**
95% of endpoints patched within 30 days of release
**Backups**
Daily backups with a successful restore test every quarter
**Onboarding**
New joiner ready with device and access on day one
**Security**
MFA on 100% of user accounts; zero repeat incidents from the same root cause
  
  
What we offer
  
  

* Competitive salary: ₹[X]–[Y] LPA, based on experience.
* Health insurance, paid leave and a learning budget for certifications.
* Ownership of IT at a growing company, with room to build the function.

How to apply
  
  
Send your CV and a short note on a system you improved to [careers email], with the subject "IT System Administrator – [Your Name]".
